segments.sn35.154:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.154:1.3: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, indriyasampanno hotī”ti?
segments.sn35.154:2.1: “Cakkhundriye ce, bhikkhu, udayabbayānupassī viharanto cakkhundriye nibbindati … pe … jivhindriye ce, bhikkhu, udayabbayānupassī viharanto jivhindriye nibbindati … pe … manindriye ce, bhikkhu, udayabbayānupassī viharanto manindriye nibbindati.
segments.sn35.154:2.4: Nibbindaṃ virajjati … pe … vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn35.154:2.5: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.

lines: Tattha yena cha indriyāni sammasitvā arahattaṃ pattaṃ, so tehi nibbisevanehi indriyehi samannāgatattā, cakkhādīni vā cha indriyāni sammasantassa uppannehi saddhādīhi indriyehi samannāgatattā paripuṇṇindriyo nāma hoti, taṃ sandhāya bhagavā cakkhundriye cetiādinā nayena desanaṃ vitthāretvā ettāvatā kho bhikkhu indriyasampanno hotīti āha.
154-155. “Sampannasīlā, bhikkhave, viharathā”tiādīsu (ma. ni.1.64) viya paripuṇṇattho idha sampanna -saddoti āha “paripuṇṇindriyo”ti.
Indriyehi samannāgatattā paripuṇṇindriyo nāma hotīti sambandho.
Evaṃ sati samannāgamasampatti vuttā hotīti āsaṅkanto “cakkhādīni vā”tiādimāha.
Heṭṭhā khandhiyavagge khandhavasena desanā āgatā, idha āyatanavasenāti āha “vuttanayamevā”ti.
